description: This file defines the 'GenericDAO' class, a data access object responsible for CRUD operations and query handling for entities within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for inserting, updating, selecting, and deleting entities, as well as complex query construction with support for conditions, views, and relation-based data retrieval.

classes.name: GenericDAO
classes.description: A data access object providing CRUD operations and complex query capabilities for entities within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getGenericDAO
methods.description: Factory method to retrieve a shared instance of GenericDAO associated with a given helperInfo.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a single GenericEntity into the database.

methods.name: insertAll
methods.description: Inserts multiple GenericValues of the same entity type into the database.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing entity in the database based on its primary keys.

methods.name: updateAll
methods.description: Updates all records matching the entity's keys.

methods.name: singleUpdate
methods.description: Performs an update on a single entity, handling lock checks and timestamp fields.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Retrieves an entity from the database based on its primary keys.

methods.name: partialSelect
methods.description: Retrieves specific fields of an entity based on given keys.

methods.name: selectListIteratorByCondition
methods.description: Executes a query based on complex conditions, returning an iterator over the results.

methods.name: selectCountByCondition
methods.description: Returns the count of entities matching specified conditions.

methods.name: selectByMultiRelation
methods.description: Retrieves related entities based on multiple relation models.

methods.name: updateByCondition
methods.description: Performs an update on entities matching specified conditions.

methods.name: singleUpdateView
methods.description: Handles updating entities that are views, with logic for managing underlying member entities.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an entity from the database, with exception handling and resource management.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an entity using a provided SQLProcessor, throws exception if entity is a view entity.

methods.name: deleteByCondition
methods.description: Deletes entities based on a specified condition, with special handling for view entities.

methods.name: deleteByCondition
methods.description: Performs delete based on a condition using a given SQLProcessor, returns number of rows affected.

methods.name: checkDb
methods.description: Checks the database schema against provided model entities, populates messages, with option to add missing entities.

methods.name: induceModelFromDb
methods.description: Creates model entity representations based on current database schema, returning list of ModelEntity objects.
